title: Listen: Are EU sanctions against Russia really affecting the war effort?
lede: The EU is preparing its 22nd package of sanctions against Russia. It is expected before the end of the year. This time, the measures are set to target more banks and crypto assets, as well as more ships from the so-called shadow fleet, those cargo that transport Russian oil, often under false flags. So, are those sanctions actually putting pressure on Russia?
